explanatorySections.title: How to use this planner
body: Answer a few questions about your arrival stage, household, and work timing. Generate a week-by-week plan for DigiD, GP, payments, transport, and other settlement tasks from roughly week 2 through month 3.
For first-week registration and BSN sequencing, use the Arrival Planner first. For phase explanations, delays, and edge cases, read the First 90 Days guide.

infographic.alt: Infographic showing the first 90 days after moving to the Netherlands including setup tasks, daily life organization and settling into routines

introParagraphs: This interactive planner builds a personalized 90-day settlement timeline for the Netherlands. It is a task tool — not a replacement for the First 90 Days guide, which explains phases, common delays, and admin health checks.

disclosure: This planner provides general relocation planning guidance only. It is not legal, immigration, tax, financial, or municipality-specific advice.
